name: Workiz
summary: Field service software with three plans, each with unlimited estimates and a price book.
differentiator: Puts unlimited estimates and a price book in every plan but shows no price on the page we read, so you have to request one.
pricing: No price published on the pages we read. The page says annual billing saves "$400+" over monthly.

scope.takeoff: None described on the pages we read.
scope.library: Unlimited estimates and a price book in Standard, Pro and Ultimate.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Price book you maintain. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Small service shops that want estimates and a price book on any plan.
skipIf: You want to compare a price before contacting the vendor.
watchOut: "Most popular" on the Ultimate plan is the vendor's own label.
